text.es: Varios usuarios en Coyoacán expresan que sus perros disfrutan de la convivencia y reciben un trato cariñoso durante su estadía. Sin embargo, una reseña crítica denuncia que su perro regresó lesionado en dos ocasiones debido a falta de supervisión entre los animales hospedados.
text.en: Several guardians in Coyoacán report that their dogs enjoy socializing and receive affectionate care during their stays. However, a critical review strongly complains that a pet returned injured twice due to an apparent lack of supervision among the boarding dogs.

text.en: Most reviews describe the facility in Parque San Andrés as a pleasant and comfortable environment for canine play and boarding. Conversely, a negative account questions the safety protocols of the premises following incidents that required subsequent veterinary treatment.
